text_ar:
و حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُكْرِي أَرْضَهُ بِالذَّهَبِ وَالْوَرِقِ
text_ar_search:
و حدثني مالك عن هشام بن عروة عن أبيه
أنه كان يكري أرضه بالذهب والورق
text_en:
Malik related to me from Hisham ibn Urwa that his father used to
rent out his land for gold and silver.


Malik was asked about
a man who rented his field for 100 sa of dates or part of its produce
of wheat or from other than its produce. He disapproved of that.
text_id: Telah menceritakan kepadaku Malik dari [Hisyam bin 'Urwah] dari [Bapaknya] Bahwasanya ia menyewakan tanahnya dengan menggunakan emas dan perak."
